features.text: PRECISION HINGED DESIGN: Goniometer hinge allows adjustable control for wrist flexion synergy therapy.
EXTENDED LATERAL SUPPORT: Stabilizes the forearm for consistent alignment and reduced strain.
CUSTOM “BEND TO FIT” PLATFORM: Moldable hand base and thumb stall ensure tailored comfort and therapeutic accuracy.
PROGRESSIVE EXTENSION THERAPY: Enables gradual stretching to restore range of motion and reduce contractures.
DURABLE, LIGHTWEIGHT MATERIALS: Engineered for long-term clinical or home use with comfort padding.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.
